title: Assassin's Creed Mirage: Master Assassin Edition
shortDescription: Experience an immersive adventure in Assassin's Creed Mirage: Master Assassin Edition, featuring the base game and six additional packs. The game returns to the series' roots, focusing on a compelling story, stealth gameplay, and parkour in 9th-century Baghdad.
description:
# Story
Set in Baghdad during the Islamic Golden Age, "Assassin's Creed Mirage" follows the journey of Basim Ibn Ishaq, a young street thief who joins the Hidden Ones in pursuit of vengeance and justice. The narrative delves into his transformation from a street thief to a master assassin, exploring his internal struggles and personal revelations.

# Gameplay
The game returns to the series' roots by emphasizing stealth, parkour, and assassinations. Players can seamlessly navigate the city, utilize a variety of tools, and execute creative assassinations. Investigation missions allow players to gather intelligence and meticulously plan their assassinations.

# Features
- Detailed open world reflecting 9th-century Baghdad.
- Return to classic gameplay with a focus on stealth and parkour.
- Additional packs inspired by "Prince of Persia," "Fire Demon," and "Jinn."
- Rich narrative experience with complex characters and diverse missions.

minimum.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB)

recommended.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB)

title: Neon Drift
shortDescription: A blistering arcade racer set in a rain-soaked synthwave metropolis. Chain drifts, dodge traffic and chase midnight leaderboard glory across 40 neon-drenched circuits.
description:
# Race the midnight city
Neon Drift is a pure arcade racer built around one thing: flow. Every corner is a chance to chain a longer drift, every straight a chance to nail the perfect boost.

# Gameplay
- 40 hand-built circuits across five neon districts.
- Momentum-based drifting with an easy-to-learn combo system.
- Daily ghost runs and online leaderboards.
- Full controller support with analog drift control.

# Features
- A pumping synthwave soundtrack from 14 artists.
- Livery editor with 200+ decals.
- Photo mode with replay timeline scrubbing.

minimum.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560

recommended.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

title: Shadow Protocol
shortDescription: A tense top-down tactical stealth game. Infiltrate corporate black sites, ghost past guards and extract the data — or leave no witnesses.
description:
# Ghost in
Shadow Protocol is a top-down tactical stealth game about patience, routing and clean exits. You are Agent Kestrel — no guns, no gadgets that save you, just your eyes and the dark.

# Gameplay
- 16 sandbox missions set across corporate black sites.
- Dynamic guard routines — no two patrols play out the same.
- Non-lethal takedowns, shadows, sound lures and vent networks.
- Full mission replay with leaderboards for ghost runs.

# Features
- Hardcore permadeath mode.
- Level editor with community sharing.

minimum.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 (2 GB) / AMD Radeon HD 7950
